expectations.buyer: Event organizers, sponsors, agencies, venues, and measurement vendors
expectations.pain: Sponsors receive inconsistent post-event evidence and cannot connect exposure to agreed deliverables
expectations.strongestIncumbent: Event platforms, CRM, ticketing, media monitoring, surveys, agencies, and sponsorship measurement firms
